I'm using Intel Ultra 9 285K, and I found that VRChat always causes bluescreen within 24hours. I replaced new CPU, replaced new Memory, tried all version of BIOS, and tried Windows 10 22H2/Windows 11 23H2/Windows 11 24H2. The OS testing the game is all renew installed. (I have already tested for three weeks)

Usually I'm using VRChat with Quest3 and VD.

Bluescreen report shows that it's caused by VRChat.
